 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Coram: Vinay Joshi And Mrs.Vrushali V. Joshi, Jj.

2. This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report bearing Crime No.89 of 2024 registered with the Deulgaon Raja, District Buldhana for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is the applicant's contention that both are matured having relations since long and it is a case of consensual relationship.
The applicant has produced some What's App chats to substantiate his contention.
4. Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable after eight weeks.
Learned Addl.P.P. waives notice on behalf of the State.
5. In the meantime, investigation may go on but charge-sheet shall not be filed without obtaining leave of this Court against the present applicant.
(MRS. VRUSHALI V. JOSHI, J.) (VINAY JOSHI, J.) Trupti Jitendra S/O Shivaji Salve vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr. Pso Ps ...
